message.content:
The volume \(V\) of a cone is given by

\[
V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2}h
\]

where \(r\) is the base radius and \(h\) is the height.

For \(r = 3\ \text{cm}\) and \(h = 5\ \text{cm}\):

\[
V = \frac{1}{3}\pi (3)^2(5) = \frac{1}{3}\pi (9)(5) = \frac{1}{3}\pi (45) = 15\pi
\]

So the volume is

\[
\boxed{15\pi\ \text{cm}^3}
\]

Numerically, \(15\pi \approx 47.12\ \text{cm}^3\).
